lines.en: label rikaspecial1:
scene rikacomesearly1
: Are you two going to explain why you’re here? Or are you just going to keep staring at me without saying anything?
lines.zh: : 你们俩打算解释一下为什么在这儿吗？还是打算就这么盯着我，一句话也不说？

lines.en: So, I guess this is my life now.
lines.zh: 所以，我猜这就是我现在的日常了。

lines.en: Rin and Noriko wasted no time at all coming here, following me straight from the classroom as soon as the final bell rang.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Noriko 一点时间都没浪费，放学铃一响就跟着我，从教室一路跟到了这里。

lines.en: It has been roughly three minutes of silence since they closed the door, meaning neither one of them has said a word yet.
lines.zh: 从她们关上门到现在，已经沉默了大约三分钟，也就是说她们俩到这会儿一个字都还没说。

lines.en: I give it three more minutes before I need to sacrifice one of them as a show of strength to send the other one running away.
lines.zh: 我给自己再宽限三分钟——再不开口，我就得把其中一个拿出来献祭，杀鸡儆猴，好把另一个吓跑。

lines.en: But which one should it be?
lines.zh: 不过该挑哪个呢？

lines.en: menu:
Sacrifice Noriko
lines.zh: 献祭 Noriko

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Noriko. But you are going to have to die.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Noriko。但你非死不可。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly2
: Tch! Damn it!
lines.zh: : 嘁！可恶！

lines.en: : Pay up, Rin. A deal’s a deal- and I win even if it means I am going to be sacrificed.
lines.zh: : 付钱吧，Rin。说好的就是说好的——就算我要被献祭，这局也算我赢。

lines.en: : If there is anything I have learned from killing hookers in Grand Theft Auto, it’s that you always get your money back once they die.
lines.zh: : 要说我在《侠盗猎车手》里杀妓女学到了什么，那就是——她们一死，钱准能拿回来。

lines.en: : I feel like I am missing a lot of context right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我现在缺了一大段前情提要。

lines.en: Sacrifice Rin
lines.zh: 献祭 Rin

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Rin. But I need to sacrifice you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Rin。但我得拿你献祭。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly3
: Hah...damn it.
lines.zh: : 哈……可恶。

lines.en: : Hell yeah! Thanks so much, Sensei! I’m now 500 yen richer thanks to you!
lines.zh: : 太爽了！太谢谢你了，Sensei！托你的福，我现在多了 500 日元！

lines.en: : You’re...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly4
: We made a bet to see whose name you’d say first. I’m not sure we would have if we knew it was going to result in one of us dying, but hey. A bet’s a bet.
lines.zh: : 我们打了个赌，赌你会先喊谁的名字。要是早知道结果会是我们其中一个送命，我可不确定我们还打不打这个赌——不过嘛，赌就是赌。

lines.en: : What an exciting and productive use of your time. I completely understand why you came directly to my office after school now and not to...whichever room the light music club practices in.
lines.zh: : 你们这时间用得可真刺激、真有成效。我现在完全明白你们放学后为什么直奔我的办公室，而不是去……轻音部排练的那间教室了。

lines.en: : Noriko and I are taking the day off. No practice for us, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我和 Noriko 今天请假。我们不用排练，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well...it’s less “taking the day off” and more “giving Otoha some time alone with Sana.”
lines.zh: : 嗯……与其说是「请假」，不如说是「给 Otoha 和 Sana 留点独处的时间」。

lines.en: : Non-sexual time, of course. I made sure to check. You never know what kind of tricks Sana might be hiding up her sleeves.
lines.zh: : 当然是非性方面的独处时间。我特意确认过了。谁知道 Sana 袖子里藏着什么花样呢。

lines.en: : And why exactly does Otoha need time alone with Sana?
lines.zh: : 那 Otoha 到底为什么需要和 Sana 独处？

lines.en: : Sana’s still really weak when it comes to drums and Otoha has a fair bit of experience, so we’re dedicating today to some one-on-one training.
lines.zh: : Sana 打鼓还是很菜，而 Otoha 经验相当丰富，所以今天我们专门安排了一对一训练。

lines.en: : But mostly because we’d probably just get in the way and Otoha needs to focus when she’s doing stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 不过主要还是因为我们大概只会碍事，而 Otoha 做这种事的时候需要集中精神。

lines.en: : Also, it’s not {i}really{/i} one-on-one since Chika is there..but still.
lines.zh: : 再说有 Chika 在，也{i}算不上{/i}一对一……不过都差不多啦。

lines.en: : Interesting that Chika stayed behind if the two of you decided to abstain. Seems like she’s a lot closer to you two than either of them.
lines.zh: : 有意思，你们俩都决定回避了，Chika 却留了下来。看来她跟你们俩的关系，比跟她们任何一个都近。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly5
: We’re really only “abstaining” because we’ve already been yelled at once- the {i}last{/i} time Otoha tried to help Sana.
lines.zh: : 我们之所以「回避」，其实只是因为{i}上次{/i} Otoha 想帮 Sana 的时候，我们已经被吼过一回了。

lines.en: : Us being here is what’s safest for everyone right now.
lines.zh: : 现在我们待在这儿，对所有人来说才是最安全的。

lines.en: : Just hope Chika doesn’t wind up getting on her nerves. I’m not sure how Otoha feels about someone just looming in the background, but that would make {i}me{/i} feel weird as hell if I was the one tutoring.
lines.zh: : 只希望 Chika 别把她惹烦了。{i}我{/i}不知道 Otoha 会不会介意有人在背后杵着，不过换作是我当家教，那感觉肯定怪得要死。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly6
: Chika will be totally fine. She’s good at reading people.
lines.zh: : Chika 绝对没问题。她很会看人。

lines.en: : Well...not good enough to realize when someone she’s close to has a crush on her. But, hey. Same.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过还没敏锐到能发现身边有人暗恋她。唉，我也一样。

lines.en: : I’d be worried about Sana if anything. She doesn’t exactly shine in social situations. Let alone social situations with girls she hasn’t spoken to much.
lines.zh: : 要担心的话我倒更担心 Sana。她在社交场合本来就不怎么放得开，更别提和没怎么说过话的女生待在一起了。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly7
: Oh, stop. Otoha’s a great teacher and I’m sure that Sana is completely fine.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了。Otoha 教得很好，我敢肯定 Sana 一点事都没有。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly8
{i}She was not fine.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她一点都不好。{/i}

lines.en: : Sana, chill. It’s fine to play a little slower when you’re just starting out.
lines.zh: : Sana，放轻松。刚上手的时候打慢一点也没关系的。

lines.en: : Just focus on keeping a steady rhythm going and add speed once you’re more comfortable with how everything feels.
lines.zh: : 先专心把节奏打稳，等你熟悉了手感，再慢慢提速。

lines.en: : If you keep trying to act like Travis Barker, you’re gonna burn yourself out and never want to play again.
lines.zh: : 你要是一直硬学 Travis Barker，迟早把自己练崩，再也不想碰鼓了。

lines.en: : Travis...who?...
lines.zh: : Travis……谁？……

lines.en: : Just...some guy who plays too fast. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 就是……一个打得太快的家伙。别管他。

lines.en: : Fact is, you’re really not bad. A lot better than I expected you to be at least. It’s clear you’ve got some understanding of music and, in time, I’m sure you’ll be solid.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你打得真不赖。至少比我预想的好太多了。看得出来你懂点音乐，假以时日，我相信你会很稳。

lines.en: : Just gotta...not work yourself too hard for the time being.
lines.zh: : 只是……暂时别把自己逼得太狠。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly9
: I’m sorry...I know I’m the one...holding everyone up...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我知道……是我拖了大家的后腿……

lines.en: : You’re the only one without any experience. If you {i}weren’t{/i} holding us up, it would mean that we suck.
lines.zh: : 你是唯一一个没经验的。要是你{i}不拖后腿{/i}，那说明是我们太菜了。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly10
: Maybe she should try playing along with a song instead of your metronome thingy? Music’s supposed to be, like, something you {i}feel.{/i} Right?
lines.zh: : 要不让她跟着歌打，别对着你那个节拍器了？音乐嘛，应该是……靠{i}感觉{/i}的东西吧？对吧？

lines.en: : I obviously can’t speak for Sana, but I can’t bring myself to get excited hearing “click...click...click” over and over.
lines.zh: : 我当然代表不了 Sana，但要我听一遍又一遍的「咔……咔……咔……」，我实在兴奋不起来。

lines.en: : Well, it’s a good thing you’re not the one playing then.
lines.zh: : 那还好打鼓的不是你。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly11
: Jeez. Hostile much? I’m just trying to help.
lines.zh: : 天哪。有必要这么冲吗？我只是想帮忙而已。

lines.en: : And the article I pulled up says a lot of drummers have a ton of success early on by just learning to play along with songs they like.
lines.zh: : 我查到的那篇文章说了，很多鼓手刚开始就是跟着自己喜欢的歌练，效果特别好。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly12
: Oh, okay. It {i}must{/i} be true if you found an article.
lines.zh: : 哦，这样啊。既然你查到了文章，那{i}肯定{/i}没错咯。

lines.en: : Umm...

: I’m sure there are plenty of people who benefit from that method, but it’s a lot better to drill the basics into your head rather than just bypassing the training period and hoping to pick them up along the way.
lines.zh: : 我相信确实有不少人用那套方法受益，但还是把基本功练进脑子里更靠谱，总好过跳过训练期、指望路上自己摸索出来。

lines.en: : S...Sorry to interrupt, but would any of you happen to know where...Rin Rokuhara is?
lines.zh: : 抱……抱歉打扰一下，请问你们哪位知道……Rin Rokuhara 在哪儿吗？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly13
: Huh?
: Rin? I can text her and find out. You a new teacher or something?
lines.zh: : Rin？我可以发短信问问她。你是新来的老师什么的吗？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly14
: Uhh...not quite...
lines.zh: : 呃……也不算……

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Aren't you her mom?!
lines.zh: : 你不是她妈妈吗？！

lines.en: : Because you look crazy familiar and I’m like, 99%% sure I saw you drop her off at middle school a few times.
lines.zh: : 因为你看着特别眼熟，我敢说百分之九十九肯定，我见过你好几次送她去初中。

lines.en: : Rin’s...mom? You’re here? At school? Right now?
lines.zh: : Rin 的……妈妈？你在这儿？在学校里？就现在？

lines.en: : Hahah...Guilty as charged...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……认罪……

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly15
: Uhh...okay. Hi.
lines.zh: : 呃……好。你好。

lines.en: : I’m...Otoha Okakura.
lines.zh: : 我……我是 Otoha Okakura。

lines.en: : Rin’s...girlfriend.
lines.zh: : Rin 的……女朋友。

lines.en: : It’s...really nice to finally meet you.
lines.zh: : 能……终于见到你，真的很高兴。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly16
: Oh, shit!
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了！

lines.en: : And I’m Chika Chosokabe. Rin’s friend.
lines.zh: : 我是 Chika Chosokabe。Rin 的朋友。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly17
: Oh...{i}shit.{/i}
: Welp, I can see that I’m not needed here. But it was nice meeting you!
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来这儿用不上我了。不过很高兴认识你！

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly18
: I’m sorry, I...I probably should have realized that you and Rin would be in the same club. She’s going to kill me if she finds out I met you like this.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我……我早该想到你和 Rin 会在同一个社团。要是她知道我是这样跟你见面的，非杀了我不可。

lines.en: : Rin is? No way. She’s been gung-ho about getting me to meet you and your partner for months now.
lines.zh: : Rin 会吗？不会吧。这几个月她一直特别起劲地想让我见见你和你伴侣呢。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly19
: Ahh, yes...the partner I still have.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊……我那个还在的伴侣。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} should be the one apologizing for delaying things for so long. I just...well, you see, {i}my{/i} parents aren’t as “progressive” as you two and-
lines.zh: : 该道歉的是{i}我{/i}，拖了这么久。我只是……嗯，你也看到了，{i}我爸妈{/i}没你们俩那么「开明」，而且——

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly20
: And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: : Mrs...Rokuhara?...
lines.zh: : Rokuhara……女士？……

lines.en: : Not now, not now, not now! Any time but now!
lines.zh: : 别现在，别现在，别现在！什么时候都行，就是别现在！

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly21
: ...and that’s exactly why soy-based protein is extremely good for you so long as you work out a proper diet!
lines.zh: : ……所以说，只要把饮食搭配好，大豆蛋白对身体是极好的！

lines.en: : Stop trying to convert me, Noriko. I get enough of that out of Yasu.
lines.zh: : 别想策反我了，Noriko。Yasu 那边已经够我受的了。

lines.en: : There’s a difference between conversion and education, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 策反和科普是两回事，Sensei。

lines.en: : All I’m doing is providing information that {i}you{/i} can use to make your {i}own{/i} decision. I’d never judge you for having a different opinion than me.
lines.zh: : 我只是提供信息，好让{i}你{/i}{i}自己{/i}做决定罢了。我绝不会因为你的看法跟我不一样就说三道四。

lines.en: : That’s weird because your sister judges me for having literally any opinion at all.
lines.zh: : 这就怪了，你姐姐可是连我有一丁点看法都要审判。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s just her archetype. I’m the exact opposite. I would {i}never{/i} be mean to you because I’m worried it would impede the amount of time I am able to spend in your presence.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那就是她的「人设」。我正好相反。我{i}绝不{/i}会对你刻薄，因为我怕那样会害我能待在你身边的时间变少。

lines.en: : Stop liking me so much. It’s scary.
lines.zh: : 别这么喜欢我。挺吓人的。

lines.en: : Never.
lines.zh: : 绝不可能。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly22
: How are you doing over there, Rin? You went silent after Noriko started talking about vegetarianism and just never recovered.
lines.zh: : 你那边还好吗，Rin？Noriko 一开始聊素食主义你就沉默了，到现在都没缓过来。

lines.en: : Chika’s being weird. I think something is going on in the club room.
lines.zh: : Chika 有点不对劲。我觉得社团教室里出事了。

lines.en: : Are Otoha and Sana making out? Is {i}that{/i} why Otoha was so insistent on-
lines.zh: : Otoha 和 Sana 在接吻吗？{i}所以{/i} Otoha 才那么坚持要——

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly23
: OH, FUCK!
lines.zh: : 哦，操！

lines.en: : I HAVE TO GO!
lines.zh: : 我得走了！

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly24
: Wow. Maybe they actually {i}were{/i} making out.
lines.zh: : 哇。说不定她们{i}真在{/i}接吻。

lines.en: : Poor Rin. Just can’t catch a break.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Rin。就是捞不着一点好。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly25
: Anyway...it’s just the two of us now...I sure hope no one takes advantage of me...
lines.zh: : 总之……现在就剩我们俩了……我真希望没人趁机占我便宜……

lines.en: : We both know you’d pull back the second I try.
lines.zh: : 咱俩都清楚，我一动手你就会缩回去。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly26
: Probably. But you can take solace in knowing that I’d kick myself for it while rubbing one out later.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过你可以安慰自己——我事后边自己解决边懊悔得想踹自己。

lines.en: : But, undying desire to be with you under only the most perfect of circumstances aside, what do you wanna talk about now that we’re alone?
lines.zh: : 不过，撇开那份「非得在最完美的时机才肯和你在一起」的执念不谈，现在我们独处了，你想聊点什么？

lines.en: : Halloween’s coming up. You going to dress up this year?
lines.zh: : 万圣节快到了。今年你要扮装吗？

lines.en: : Do I really look like the type of person to dress up for Halloween?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是会为万圣节扮装的人吗？

lines.en: : You look like the type of person {i}I{/i} want to dress up for Halloween.
lines.zh: : 你看起来像是那种{i}我{/i}愿意为他扮装的人。

lines.en: : I’m a little more interested in what you’ll be wearing. Going to raid your sister’s closet and then beg for me to finger you again?
lines.zh: : 我更感兴趣的是你会穿什么。打算翻你姐姐的衣柜，然后再求我用手指伺候你？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly27
: Hey, that’s mean. I was going through some shit back then. Granted, I’m going through some shit right now as well. But I was going through shit back then too.
lines.zh: : 喂，这话真伤人。那阵子我正经历一堆破事。当然，我现在也在经历一堆破事。但那时候我也是真的在经历破事啊。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly28

: But no. I’m hoping to make it through the entire holiday this year without trying to force something to happen between us. Which allows me to perfectly segue into the reason for all of that- my darling sister.
lines.zh: : 不过没有。今年我希望整个假期都别硬逼着我们之间发生什么。这也正好让我顺理成章地转到造成这一切的根源上——我亲爱的姐姐。

lines.en: : What about her?
lines.zh: : 她怎么了？

lines.en: : How are things with you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩现在怎么样？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : You know exactly what I mean. I want to know if you guys are in love again yet.
lines.zh: : 你很清楚我什么意思。我想知道你们是不是又爱上了。

lines.en: : I’m sure Niki will waste no time at all in telling you if we are.
lines.zh: : 要是我们又爱上了，Niki 肯定一秒钟都不会耽搁就告诉你。

lines.en: : She already talks about you all the time. The only side I don’t fully understand is yours.
lines.zh: : 她本来就整天念叨你。我唯一摸不透的就是你这边。

lines.en: : Are you, like...waiting for something? Because I could have sworn her letters would have been the nail in your coffin.
lines.zh: : 你是不是……在等什么？因为我敢发誓，她那些信本来该是钉死你棺材的那颗钉子。

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about this with you, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你聊这个，Noriko。

lines.en: : Is it because I’m around the same age she was when she used to give you blowjobs under the blanket on our living room couch?
lines.zh: : 是因为我现在差不多就是她当年的年纪吗？就是她在我们家客厅沙发上、钻进毯子里给你口交的那个时候。

lines.en: : It’s because the only relationship I want to talk about with you is the one that {i}we{/i} have.
lines.zh: : 是因为我唯一想跟你谈的关系，就是{i}我们{/i}之间这一段。

lines.en: : Not the one I have with some other Nakayama who apparently used to give me blowjobs under the blanket on your living room couch.
lines.zh: : 不是我和另一个 Nakayama 之间那段——那个据说当年在你家客厅沙发上钻进毯子里给我口交的 Nakayama。

lines.en: : Sounds like they were pretty bad blowjobs if you can’t even remember. I promise to work a little harder and make mine memorable once I’m done with all of this self-sacrificing.
lines.zh: : 听上去那口交技术挺差的，你居然都不记得了。我保证会更努力，等我这阵子的自我牺牲折腾完了，一定让你记一辈子。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And when will that be?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那要等到什么时候？

lines.en: : Sometime after Halloween, hopefully.
lines.zh: : 希望是万圣节之后吧。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ve been feeling really {i}hot{/i} lately...and I'm not sure how much longer I can keep it all in.
lines.zh: : 我最近感觉特别{i}热{/i}……而且我不知道自己还能憋多久。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly29
: Mom.
: Heeeeeey, Rin. Nice to...be in the same...building as you...for the first time today...
lines.zh: : 嘿—————呀，Rin。今天第一次……和你待在同一栋……楼里，真高兴啊……

lines.en: : What do you think you’re doing?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己这是在干什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know...a little crying...a little...more crying...
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的……哭了一点……又……多哭了一点……

lines.en: : And the suit?
lines.zh: : 那这身西装呢？

lines.en: : That {i}interview{/i} you had...
lines.zh: : 你说的那个{i}面试{/i}……

lines.en: : Where was it?
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly30

: L-Look at it this way! If your club goes any longer without an advisor, it might get shut down! And it’s better off having somebody who knows what they’re talking about than some random person, right?!
lines.zh: : 换——换个角度想！你们社团再这么没有顾问老师下去，搞不好会被废社！与其找个随便什么人，不如找个懂行的，对吧？！

lines.en: : Mom! How am I supposed to have a fun and exciting high school life if {i}you’re{/i} there too?! You’re 43 years old!
lines.zh: : 妈！你也在那儿的话，我还怎么过又爽又刺激的高中生活啊？！{i}你{/i}都 43 岁了！

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly31
: Stop spreading misinformation! I’m 42 and you know it!
lines.zh: : 别散布谣言！我 42 岁，你心里清楚！

lines.en: : You’ve still lived my entire life more than twice! You don’t need to live it a third time! Let me have this!
lines.zh: : 你都已经把我这辈子活过两遍还多了！不需要再活第三遍！让我自己过！

lines.en: : Rin...why didn’t you tell me?
lines.zh: : Rin……你为什么不告诉我？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly32

lines.zh: : 所以……

lines.en: : I guess you found out.
lines.zh: : 我猜你已经知道了。

lines.en: : Yeah. And now I feel like an asshole for making your mom cry within five minutes of meeting her.
lines.zh: : 是啊。现在我觉得自己是个混蛋——才认识你妈五分钟就把她弄哭了。

lines.en: : It’s my fault. I should have stayed in the dorm. Oh, and by dorm, I mean a different dorm. Not the one you guys live in since I am 42 and living there would be wrong.
lines.zh: : 是我的错。我该待在宿舍里的。哦，顺便说清楚，我说的是另一间宿舍。不是你们住的那间——毕竟我 42 岁了，住那儿不合适。

lines.en: : Is she actually 42?
lines.zh: : 她真的 42 岁吗？

lines.en: : She’s 43.
scene rikacomesearly33
: That’s it! You’re grounded! Go to our room!
lines.zh: : 够了！你被禁足了！回我们房间去！

lines.en: : Phpbhpbhpbt!
lines.zh: : 噗噜噗噜噗！

lines.en: : Rin, seriously. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : Rin，说真的。到底怎么回事？

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly34
: I really wasn’t trying to hide anything from you, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 我真的不是想瞒你什么，Otoha……

lines.en: : I didn’t even know until super recently, so...this is all pretty messed up for me as well. I haven’t even finished wrapping my head around everything yet.
lines.zh: : 我也是最近才知道的，所以……这事对我来说也挺操蛋的。我自己都还没完全理清楚。

lines.en: : Do you...wanna like...like, talk about it or something?
lines.zh: : 你……想不想要……就是，聊聊什么的？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...not with my mom here.
lines.zh: : 想，但是……不想在我妈在这儿的时候聊。

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly35
: Maybe...after practice then?
lines.zh: : 那……等排练结束之后？

lines.en: : I still have to teach Sana how to-
lines.zh: : 我还得教 Sana 怎么——

lines.en: : No. Go talk now. Waiting on things never helps.
lines.zh: : 不。现在就去聊。拖着从来不管用。

lines.en: : Oh, and neither do flowers apparently, so don’t go buying each other roses or something. It’ll just make you look like a loser whose only redeeming factor is how good she is at- nope. Shouldn’t say that.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，看来送花也没用，所以别去买什么玫瑰之类的。那只会让你看起来像个废物，唯一的优点就是她那方面有多厉害——不行。这话不该说。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m still unemployed technically, but I know my way around instruments.
lines.zh: : 总之，严格来说我现在还失业着，不过摆弄乐器我还是在行的。

lines.en: : I’ll hang out here while you two go do cutesy girlfriend stuff. Love is stupid. I hate this.
lines.zh: : 你们俩去做那些黏黏糊糊的女朋友的事吧，我在这儿待着。爱情真蠢。我讨厌这玩意儿。

lines.en: : Can we...talk later too? Please?
lines.zh: : 我们……等会儿也能聊聊吗？拜托？

lines.en: : I still have...a lot of questions...
lines.zh: : 我还有……好多问题……

lines.en: scene rikacomesearly36
: Yeah. We’ll talk tonight.
lines.zh: : 好。我们今晚聊。

lines.en: : I’ll pick up a pizza on the way home.
lines.zh: : 我回家路上买个披萨。

lines.en: : Pepperoni, please.
lines.zh: : 要意式辣香肠的，拜托。

lines.en: : Are there even other toppings?
lines.zh: : 披萨还有别的口味吗？
